title: Vesperine SMP
description: This a modpack for the Players of the Vesprine SMP.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84c4d297ddc6e8cab3a3a1e308723ac24ff898fd.png)
![sub text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/809a1948516d40a0ffd87b7ef1efcada59335acb.png)
### Welcome to the Vesperine SMP!
This is a mod pack for roleplay with magical ablitiys. This modpack includes mods for personalization, Quality of life, and other cool stuff.
- This modpack includes 3D Skin Layers, Essentials, and Armorer's Workshop to give you the ablitiy personalize your character and improve roleplay.
- New places to explore like the new cave biomes, The end, and learn new recipes for food with Let's Do it and Farmer's delight.
- Includes mods that improve proformance and ensure a _less_ laggy time playing this modpack.
- Includes a resource pack named "title" this is personaly made by me and includes a title change and adds new splashes and is marked as unlisted on modrinth.
